annotations.title: Find Hawaiʻi lots in an area

description: Use this when someone wants nearby Hawaiʻi lots that fit zoning, size, flood zone or Special Management Area filters, around a lot, an address or a TMK prefix.

flood.description: in: center in a FEMA special flood hazard area. out: not.

island.description: Kauaʻi, Oʻahu, Maui County or Hawaiʻi Island. Not needed with tmk_prefix or near_tmk.

near_address.description: Or around this Hawaiʻi street address

radius_m.description: Meters around near_tmk or lat and lon. Default 500, up to 3000.

sma.description: in or out of the Special Management Area

tmk_prefix.description: Start of a TMK: island, zone, section and optionally plat, e.g. 4-4-2 or 4-4-2-016

zoning.description: Text to match in the zoning code or name, e.g. R-4, Agriculture, Resort

name: search_lots
title: Find Hawaiʻi lots in an area
